## Page 123

Calculation of House Cusps 139 are headed "Min" (minutes). Because the same proportion (1:60) exists between hours and minutes of time as exists between degrees and minutes of arc, the columns can be used to represent either hours of time or degrees of arc; the rows can be used for minutes of time or minutes of arc. The same proportion (1:60) exists between minutes and seconds of time; therefore, the table can be adapted to the problem in Step 5 by using the hours columns for minutes and the minutes rows for seconds.
